en: Vintage black‑and‑white city view looking down a tree‑lined street flanked by ornate multi‑story buildings, hotels, and cafés. The perspective shows a narrow valley with hills in the background. Text at the top reads "Karlsbad. Untere Parkstrasse." Numbers in red ink are written and crossed out on the upper center. Signs on buildings include hotel names such as "Hotel …" and "Weilburg." and a shop sign "Ernst Die…". The scene is busy with terraces, awnings, and outdoor seating, typical of a spa resort town.
